title: AI-Driven Virtual Try-On and Garment Generation System for Sustainable Indian Fashion
summary: A generative-AI fashion proposal combines virtual try-on and garment design. Lower returns, less waste, and improved artisan opportunities are intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A generative-AI fashion proposal with a demonstration combines virtual try-on and garment design. Lower returns, less waste, and improved artisan opportunities remain intended benefits.
purpose: Help shoppers and designers make better garment choices with less waste.
system: AI virtual try-on and garment-generation system

ratings.reason: Shoppers and artisans are intended to receive better fit information and design opportunities.
Fashion businesses are intended to reduce returns and overproduction; no realized result is supplied.
Lower textile waste and emissions are intended environmental benefits, not measured effects.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: AI-Driven Virtual Try-On and Garment Generation System for Sustainable Indian Fashion

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish specific replication requirements.

headline: Virtual try-on for Indian fashion
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
